About us

At Connexa, we believe in bringing people closer through genuine, real-time conversations. Our platform focuses solely on video and audio calls, allowing you to connect face-to-face without the distractions of messaging. Whether you're meeting new friends, reconnecting with old ones, or simply looking to share moments live, Connexa offers a safe and easy way to build authentic relationships.

Privacy and security are our top priorities, ensuring your calls are protected and comfortable. Join Connexa today and experience friendship in its most natural form through real voice and real faces.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is Connexa?

Connexa is a social platform that helps you connect with new people through audio and video calls no messaging, just real-time conversations.

Is Connexa a dating app?

No Connexa is designed for friendship and real conversations, not dating. We promote safe, respectful, and platonic connections.

How is Connexa different from other apps?

Connexa removes messaging distractions and focuses only on voice and video, creating space for real, human conversations.

Is there an age limit to use Connexa?

Yes, users must be 18 years or older to join and use Connexa.

Can I block or report someone?

Yes, you can block or report any user instantly from their profile or during a call to keep your experience safe.
